title: 1988 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: The diagram shows part of a scale of a measuring device. The arrow indicates an approximate reading of

solutions.text:
The scale is divided into fourths between \(10\) and \(11,\) so the interior tick marks fall at \(10.25,\) \(10.5,\) and \(10.75.\)

The arrow points just past the \(10.25\) mark, so the reading is between \(10.25\) and \(10.5.\) Of the choices, only \(10.3\) lies in that range.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: The marks between \(10\) and \(11\) divide that unit into four equal parts, so each small division is \(0.25\)
The arrow sits just past the first mark after \(10,\) so the reading is a little more than \(10.25\)
